# LZMA SDK (7z decoder)

C files from the LZMA SDK / 7-Zip 26.06 (`C/` folder of
https://github.com/ip7z/7zip), by Igor Pavlov, **public domain**.

Only the 7z archive decoder is used (LZMA, LZMA2, BCJ/BCJ2, Delta filters):
PersonalDepth extracts the `.7z` archives of external data (Shom BathyElli
surfaces). See `src/core/Archive.cpp`.

Fichiers C du LZMA SDK / 7-Zip 26.06 (Igor Pavlov, domaine public) :
décodeur des archives `.7z` des données externes.
